reviews.comment: This class is difficult. You need to stay on top of your work because there are assignments due pretty much every week and they take a long time to complete. He does give a ton of extra credit and an 85 is an A, so it takes the stress off of trying to get a high grade.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The lectures are not very useful for the coding you have to do but he offers a lot of extra credit to make it easy. I ended with over a 100 in the class because of the amount of extra credit. Anything above an 85 overall was an A.

Casey is good at maintaining structures that allow students to succeed, but make no mistake, ChatGPT is your professor, not him. You will work much closer with your TA's on anything that actually affects your grade. He is has nice extra credit opportunities, but other than attendance motivations, I derived no benefit from attending his lectures.

Professor was good though passive aggressive at times. Make a real connection with your TA since they are the ones that grade your work. Grade is based on 2 exams ( 30% each) and 4 problem sets (10% each), 1 additional is dropped and an additional 6th is extra credit at the beginning of the class. Class is much easier that it is made out to be.

Dr. Cox is very understanding that this course is difficult, so he makes an effort to meet students in the middle. There's lots of extra credit available. The TAs are very accessible for coding questions. Attend class as much as you can or you will fall behind. Don't buy the textbook. Participate and stay engaged during lecture and you'll do great!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Never went to class or TA session, but his lectures give you everything for the problem sets/exams. 5 problem sets (one dropped), two take-home exams. Plenty of extra credit!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
